strategy.name: ackman-concentrated-catalyst
strategy.description: Concentrated long-only hedge fund style: high conviction, fundamental thesis, catalyst-driven. Objective is to MAKE MONEY — active PM, not passive hold. Equity is the core book; long options are a narrow asymmetric satellite when thesis+catalyst align.

returnAspiration.note: Soft aspirations only — never force trades, size, or options to hit a multiple. Preserve capital and thesis discipline first. Prefer 1.3–1.7x over swinging for 2x.

positionCapacity.note: No fixed max position count. New entry allowed when buying_power >= minOrderUsd, cash >= minCashReservePct, invested <= maxPortfolioInvestedPct, conviction >= Media, and thesis doc exists. Prefer Ackman concentration; add names only if each gets meaningful size (>= minOrderUsd).

strategy.style: Bill Ackman — concentrated, activist mindset, quality + mispricing

options.accountNote: Agentic cash ••••3029 — option_level_2 verified. MCP single-leg only.

exitPolicy.note: Long options: premium can go to $0. Exit on thesis/catalyst break or ~7 DTE left without clear payoff. Do NOT hold to expiry hoping for lottery. Never force 2x.

options.role: Asymmetric satellite only when equity sizing cannot express a near-term Alta catalyst cheaply enough. Equity remains the core book.

riskControls.stopLossNote: Hard stop backup solo si tesis intacta; exit primario = tesis rota (Ackman)

exitPolicy.note: Ackman NO vende por % fijo. Sale cuando: (1) tesis rota, (2) tesis realizada / fair value, (3) mejor idea en otro lado. Trims parciales opcionales — nunca automáticos por +25%.
exitPolicy.defaultTrimNote: Si trim: tamaño definido en thesis (ej. 30–50% al fair value), no regla mecánica global
